summary: Backend regression coverage passed for login/bootstrap, role protection, multi-slot conflict handling, cancellation/rebooking, and doctor ownership. UI loaded the 9-chair/24-row board and quick-add modal, but a stale persisted session caused booking save to return Session expired and blocked logout.

minor.issue: Cancelled rows are filtered out, so the API does not expose cancelled history despite the cancellation-history requirement.
Bearer-token auth is used without the requested httpOnly cookie flow; CORS is wildcard with credentials disabled.

ui_bugs.issue: An expired token retained in localStorage leaves the board visible; a booking POST returns 'Session expired' inline, and the modal blocks navigation/logout with no redirect to login.

integration_issues.issue: 401 is not handled globally; the user remains trapped in the modal instead of being signed out and prompted to authenticate.

issues: Mobile relies on a horizontally overflowing 9-column grid rather than the specified mobile agenda/chair selector pattern; not fully validated after auth trap.

action_items: Add a global axios 401 handler that clears chairSession and routes to login, or validate session on load and before booking.
Expose cancelled history through an appropriate history/status endpoint or query while keeping active board filtering.
Implement the required booking edit/status/cancel UI; current frontend only supports quick-add and has no occupied-slot controls.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js has no edit/status/cancel interaction despite the PRD requiring reception/admin booking updates and cancellation UI.
CORS configuration uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False, inconsistent with explicit-origin credentialed auth guidance.
Booking update permits arbitrary chair/date/time/duration changes without rechecking unique conflicts or validating clinic hours/slot alignment.
seed_data_creation: Created two TEST-prefixed bookings on 2099 dates and cancelled one; data remains in the configured database because no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API suite passed. Re-run UI with fresh login/session, then test WebSocket propagation in two pages and occupied booking status/cancel flows after UI is implemented.
rca of the issue: The frontend stores the JWT indefinitely in localStorage and only authenticates through request headers. There is no response interceptor or session-expiry recovery, so an expired persisted token allows the board shell to render but leaves failed mutations inside the modal overlay.
